name: Quseir Amra
description: Quseir Amra is a small desert retreat in eastern Jordan, built in the early 8th century for the future Umayyad caliph Walid II. Its modest stone halls and bathhouse hide a surprise: walls and ceilings covered in vivid frescoes of hunters, dancers, craftsmen and rulers. One bath chamber even carries an early painted map of the starry sky on a dome.
